items.title: How 'dangerous' Man City maintained 100 per cent record
items.description: Match of the Day's Joe Hart and Danny Murphy analyse how Manchester City made it seven wins from seven in the Premier League with a 3-2 victory against Ipswich.

items.title: Why Liverpool are still 'too easy' to play against
items.description: Match of the Day's Danny Murphy analyses how Liverpool are still to "easy" to play against despite their 2-1 victory over Brentford.

items.description: The top stories and transfer rumours from Sunday's newspapers...

items.title: Rangers 'pop balloon' as Neil gift wastes chance to go top
items.description: Rangers were full of positive energy as they made the trip to Dundee on the back of seven straight wins. However, a Dan Neil error felt "like a balloon popping", says Derek McInnes.

items.title: Rangers miss chance to go top as Jones earns Dundee a point
items.description: Callum Jones scored a second-half equaliser as Rangers were held to a 2-2 draw by Dundee and missed the chance to go top of the Scottish Premiership.

items.title: Can Hearts prove credentials at scene of title heartbreak?
items.description: Hearts' last trip to Parkhead ended with their title dream being crushed in the space of 11 minutes. They return to face Celtic on Sunday refreshed and reshaped.

items.title: 'Sick feeling in stomach' - are Reedijk's Hibs in relegation fight?
items.description: Two games in, no points gathered and a chorus of boos greeting him at full-time at Easter Road. The honeymoon is well and truly over for Marink Reedijk.

items.title: Villa's Manzambi shows Newcastle what they missed out on
items.description: Aston Villa are a side back in form, with Johan Manzambi scoring the winner against a Newcastle team he turned down to move to Villa Park.

items.title: Diaz hat-trick fires Bayern to win in Kane's 100th Bundesliga game
items.description: Harry Kane scored on his 100th Bundesliga appearance while Luis Diaz netted a hat-trick as Bayern Munich thrashed RB Leipzig 6-1 to go top of the table.

items.title: Lamine Yamal opens scoring as Barcelona beat Real Betis
items.description: Lamine Yamal, Rodri, Gabriel Jesus, Eric Garcia and Dani Olmo all scored for Barcelona as they swept aside Real Betis in a seven-goal thriller to stay five points clear at the top of La Liga.
